doc: Waivers for gecko_audit.py F1/F3/F4/F5 findings. Each waiver names one module and one address and must say why it is safe. F2 (GeckoHeapPtr) and F6 (conflicting writes) cannot be waived.

waivers.reason: PARITY toggle only. Branches to 0x80260B90, the hook of the omitted PreventColorResetRandomChar. That module's non-online-CSS path is 'restore; li r0,0' (its EXIT), and the retail word at 0x80260B90 is li r0,0 (38000000). Its only other side effect offline is clobbering volatile r3; retail code after 0x80260B94 rewrites r3 (clrlwi r3,r19,24 at 0x80260B9C) before reading it. Equivalent offline (static analysis, retail disassembly 0x80260B80-0x80260BDC).
